My VPN is blocking the URL, and I think the cli is thinking "oh this URL is unavailable, let me fall back to the next URL", and just looping through this
Hmm, then I don't know, but note that these days you may need lake exe cache get --unsafe of a variant (but it seems unrelated to your problem).
lake exe cache get still works for me =)

lake cache get is still not supported for getting mathlib artifacts. Please use lake exe cache get, which is a whole different mechanism despite the command similarity.

The plausible lines you're seeing is lake trying to resolve the latest outputs for that package by walking the history back: it will do that for 100 commits by default. It should only keep walking back on 404, so it's probably not about your VPN, and just that these are really not available in the Reservoir cache that lake cache is querying.
